title: The container platform must prohibit the use of cached authenticators after an organization-defined time period.
check_content:
Review the container platform configuration to determine if the platform is configured to prohibit the use of cached authenticators after an organization-defined time period. 

If the container platform is not configured to prohibit the use of cached authenticators after an organization-defined time period, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the container platform to prohibit the use of cached authenticators after an organization-defined time period.
VulnDiscussion: If cached authentication information is out of date, the validity of the authentication information may be questionable.
